name: pragmatic-shared
description: The platform packages shared by the Pragmatic containers: identity contracts, realm services, stores, identity sources, per-realm adapters, component descriptors, component configuration (repository, applied object, runtime reader), the hive agent channel protocol (enrolment, signed intents, approvals, reports, placements, tunnel control), the application host, the public-edge contracts (entitlements, ledger, customer API), the application shell, the release toolkit, the Kubernetes client layer, the platform edge link, structured logging, the tenant plane both admin consoles run (transitional) and what the environment server and gateway share.
